events.verdict: Zubac (LAC) retracts his arm as Randle (MIN) leans into him to create the marginal contact during his shot attempt.
Conley (MIN) briefly places both hands to Leonard's (LAC) front, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Reid (MIN) makes contact to Zubac's (LAC) arm during his shot attempt near the basket and the contact is more than marginal.
Bogdanovic (LAC) initiates contact with Conley's (MIN) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Conley (MIN) grasps and immediately releases Dunn's (LAC) jersey.
Dunn (LAC) and Clark (MIN) briefly engage and disengage after the defensive switch.
Harden (LAC) stops and changes directions, and any contact with Clark (MIN) at the start of his drive is marginal.
Leonard (LAC) commits a take foul on McDaniels (MIN).
McDaniels (MIN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Clark (MIN) obtains a legal guarding position in front of Harden (LAC) and any contact that occurs as Harden returns to the floor is marginal.
